scope: Read-only inspection of the isolated commit, its base diff, public OpenAI-route/state-machine semantics, and committed tests. No product source was edited and no CPU/GPU command was run by this reviewer.

commit_binding.subject: fix openai restart admission
commit_binding.worktree_note: Initial inspection found one untracked r061c_openai_restart_d577e32.bundle. A post-review status also displayed .omc/ metadata paths, consistent with concurrent work. No tracked source modification was displayed; these untracked paths are outside the committed diff and were not treated as product source.

scope_assessment.product_behavior_changed: Only the public OpenAI admission behavior for maintenance_state=restarting, plus conversion of post-gate AdmissionClosedError to HTTP 503. No scheduler, OOM injection, backend restart, GPU configuration, or R061c criterion source changed in this commit.

maintenance_gate.result: serving and restarting return no route-level rejection; loading, failed, rebuilding, stopping, and unknown non-serving states retain JSON HTTP 503 rejection.
maintenance_gate.finding: The change is narrowly scoped: it does not make rebuilding generally admissible.

public_routes.result: Both routes perform the maintenance gate then invoke their existing handlers. AdmissionClosedError escaping from the real state admission path is translated to JSON HTTP 503 with the original message.

single_admission_authority.result: Both OpenAI paths ultimately call FrontendManager.new_user. During restarting it enforces RESTART_QUEUE_MAX, increments/decrements restart_waiters in a finally block, waits with RESTART_READY_TIMEOUT_S, then rechecks maintenance_state before allocating UID and stamping backend_epoch.

race_and_failure_handling.replacement_success: _on_ready sets maintenance_state=serving before setting _ready_event. A released waiter consequently rechecks serving and stamps the already advanced epoch.
race_and_failure_handling.replacement_failure: _on_failure sets maintenance_state=failed and wake_failed_restart_waiters sets the event. Released waiters fail the post-wake serving check and the route returns retryable 503.
race_and_failure_handling.cancellation: Cancelled new_user waiters propagate cancellation and the finally block decrements restart_waiters; the new route catch is limited to AdmissionClosedError and does not swallow cancellation.

evidence: test_openai_routes_admit_restarting_waiters_until_replacement_epoch_is_serving uses FastAPI TestClient against both /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions, each with streamed and non-streamed responses. Its route-level state double blocks in new_user, proves one live waiter, advances to epoch 1/serving, and asserts HTTP 200 plus epoch=1 TokenizeMsg.
test_openai_routes_keep_loading_and_failed_states_closed proves both public routes return 503 and never call new_user for loading and failed.
test_openai_routes_return_retryable_503_when_restart_admission_races_closed proves AdmissionClosedError maps to HTTP 503 for both public routes.

test_frontend_restart_wait_queue_bounds_timeout_cancel_and_failed_wakeup exercises the actual FrontendManager for timeout, full queue, cancellation cleanup, success after replacement epoch, and failed wakeup.
test_openai_gate_message_is_loading_aware asserts restarting is the sole newly open gate state and rebuilding remains closed.
test_assessment.error_contract: The reviewed API has no separate structured admission error-code field. The preserved/introduced contract is JSON error text with HTTP 503. Timeout and failed-race messages remain retryable 503; existing full-queue text remains generated by FrontendManager.
coverage_limits: The public-route test uses a route-state double and the actual FrontendManager bounds test separately; it is strong compositional coverage but not one end-to-end public route bound to a real FrontendManager instance.

There is no dedicated public-route assertion for the full-queue message, nor a client-disconnect test while a public request is parked. The actual state test covers queue-full and task cancellation cleanup, and the shared AdmissionClosedError route conversion makes their HTTP status behavior direct, but those two route-level variants remain indirect coverage.

findings.title: R061c unreachable restart waiter is repaired at the correct boundary
findings.detail: The original candidate rejected restarting before new_user. This commit allows only restarting through to the existing bounded authority and maps the state-machine's expected closure exception into the prior retryable HTTP class.

findings.title: Public full-queue and client-abort variants are not directly asserted
findings.detail: This is not a source-semantic defect found in the reviewed diff. Additions would improve regression precision, but the current committed tests already cover the relevant state-machine branches and one public AdmissionClosedError mapping.

conclusion.retest_boundary: The fix changes candidate identity from 4c878f6 to d577e32. Any formal R061c retry must bind d577e32 and fresh source/test/admission material; the original terminal raw remains failed/not_met evidence and is not altered.
conclusion.unverified_gpu_gap: No GPU model load, actual OOM/restart, live HTTP/SSE run, listener/process cleanup check, or CPU pytest result was executed or claimed by this review. Those claims must come from the executor's independent artifacts, not this source review.
